input_equivalence_audit.original_positive: Original activation and preflight use base.valid_state() with absent explicit owner_instance_id.
input_equivalence_audit.rv2_fixture_distinction: The RV2 negative adds explicit empty owner_instance_id and refreshes the canonical ticket digest.
input_equivalence_audit.separation: Only absent legacy identity may derive from exactly one current runtime-owned attestation id bound to exact project, role, task, ticket digest, and active time; explicit invalid identity never falls back.

input_equivalence_audit.area: risk acceptance, resolved evidence, and review mode
input_equivalence_audit.original_positive: Original cases use extension-empty contract-2.0 review records.
input_equivalence_audit.rv2_fixture_distinction: RV2 cases carry structured finding/operation, coverage/provenance, or mode=formal extensions.
input_equivalence_audit.separation: Extension-empty legacy records are advisory-compatible only; structured RV2 fields trigger complete exact enforcement and cannot downgrade.

input_equivalence_audit.original_positive: The original cleanup boundary has no trusted capability metadata.
input_equivalence_audit.rv2_fixture_distinction: The RV2 negative supplies trusted project_write/ordinary metadata that conflicts with caller label cleanup.
input_equivalence_audit.separation: Legacy diagnostic preflight does not establish RV2 authorization or atomicity; reserve-action is the consequential authorization boundary.

input_equivalence_audit.original_positive: Original activation uses an empty state artifact_digests map.
input_equivalence_audit.rv2_fixture_distinction: The RV2 negative explicitly declares a conflicting AGENTS.md digest.
input_equivalence_audit.separation: Verified immutable release anchors may supply distribution digests without duplicate state fields; every declared conflict rejects.

copy_package_audit.helper_behavior: base.copy_package omits the original validation-report.json while retaining executable artifacts and the RV2 report.
copy_package_audit.result: All copy_package callers are installed-overlay or anchor mutation checks. No distribution-release positive relies on the helper; report-bound distribution integrity is assigned to check-release.

limitations: The canonical state validates, but its product provenance is stale and no runtime-owned activation or effective-permission attestation is present.
Runtime-dependent production and formal-review claims remain unverified.
Package-local digest anchors cannot resist coordinated edits to protocol, lock, harness, and embedded constant.
Validation was local and used synthetic fixtures; no production or physical claim is supported.

conclusion.statement: The immutable final product passes the original 43-test suite, RV2 30-test suite, and their 73-test combined execution without failures or skips. Live runtime activation remains separately unverified.
